# hpe_morpheus_monitoring_check_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_monitoring_check_type" "example" {
  id = 5
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_monitoring_check_type" "example" {
  name = "Service Monitor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the monitoring check type
- `name` (String) The name of the monitoring check type

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The code identifier of the monitoring check type
- `create_incident` (Boolean) Whether checks of this type create incidents on failure
- `default_interval` (Number) The default polling interval (in seconds) for this check type
- `in_uptime` (Boolean) Whether checks of this type count towards uptime
- `metric_name` (String) The primary metric name reported by this check type
- `push_only` (Boolean) Whether this check type only accepts pushed results
- `tunnel_supported` (Boolean) Whether this check type supports tunneled connectivity
